fixtures.provenance: Synthetic v1, simplified-Chinese court heading. Rendered offline via ImageMagick 7.1.2 on darwin-arm64 with Hiragino Sans GB; canonical bytes committed. CI never regenerates.

render.render_command: magick -size 800x80 xc:white -font /System/Library/Fonts/Hiragino\ Sans\ GB.ttc -pointsize 44 -gravity center -annotate +0+0 '上海市浦东新区人民法院' zh-02-court-heading.png
render.source_text: 上海市浦东新区人民法院
render.notes: Court heading category — short, large display text. Engine measurement results live in the bakeoff report, not here.

fixtures.provenance: Synthetic v1, simplified-Chinese case number with half-width parentheses + ASCII digits + Chinese. Tests engine handling of half/full-width punctuation drift.

render.render_command: magick -size 800x80 xc:white -font /System/Library/Fonts/Hiragino\ Sans\ GB.ttc -pointsize 40 -gravity center -annotate +0+0 '(2025) 沪0115民初12345号' zh-03-case-number.png
render.notes: Mixed half-width punctuation + digits + Chinese. Designed to expose engine half/full-width punctuation behavior under the CER normative spec (no punctuation folding).

fixtures.provenance: Synthetic v1, simplified-Chinese paragraph from a fictional judgment opinion. Tests engine handling of a single long line of pure Chinese including a colon (：) and period (。).

render.render_command: magick -size 1200x80 xc:white -font /System/Library/Fonts/Hiragino\ Sans\ GB.ttc -pointsize 36 -gravity center -annotate +0+0 '本院经审理查明：被告于二零二五年五月签订合同。' zh-04-judgment-paragraph.png
render.source_text: 本院经审理查明：被告于二零二五年五月签订合同。
render.notes: Pure Chinese paragraph including a colon (：) and period (。).

fixtures.provenance: Synthetic v1, simplified-Chinese party-list row with intentional double-space separator between fields. Tests engine handling of inter-field whitespace under the CER normative spec.

render.render_command: magick -size 800x80 xc:white -font /System/Library/Fonts/Hiragino\ Sans\ GB.ttc -pointsize 40 -gravity center -annotate +0+0 '原告：张三  被告：李四' zh-05-party-row.png
render.source_text: 原告：张三  被告：李四
render.notes: Two parties separated by a double-space. The CER normative spec collapses whitespace runs but does not invent missing separators; engine output dropping the inter-party gap will surface as a non-zero CER (one deletion against an 11-token reference).

fixtures.provenance: Synthetic v1, simplified-Chinese case-number label with mixed CJK + Latin digits + half-width parentheses, no inter-token space. Tests the engine's handling of mixed-script tokenization adjacent to punctuation.

render.render_command: magick -size 1200x80 xc:white -font /System/Library/Fonts/Hiragino\ Sans\ GB.ttc -pointsize 36 -gravity center -annotate +0+0 '案件编号：(2025)沪0115民初12345号' zh-06-mixed-cjk-latin.png
render.notes: Mixed-script tokenization adjacent to half-width punctuation. Authored ground truth; engine measurement against this fixture lives in the bakeoff report.
